name: BORA
verdict: BORA is the brand of Bora Lüftungstechnik GmbH, a private German cooktop-extractor manufacturer founded and still led by Willi Bruckbauer. Nothing found.
note: German cooker-extractor manufacturer. Rating note (issue #603, 2026-09-29): private founder-led company; parent holding reported as Werkhaus GmbH & Co. KG (Raubling). No state ownership and no human-rights finding found.
